demoContent.title: Demo content
demoContent.description: Show or hide sample listings, projects, agencies and blog posts used for testing and demos.
demoContent.toggleDescription: The mode affects sample records only; real content is shown either way.
demoContent.noContentHint: There are no sample records in the database. Load the content with the command below first.
demoContent.byCategoryDescription: How many sample listings each property type holds.
demoContent.howVisibility: Records are not deleted — only the public query condition changes. Turning the mode off hides sample content immediately.
demoContent.howSeo: Sample pages never enter the sitemap and are not exposed to search engines, even while the mode is on.
demoContent.cmdLoad: Loads the sample content into the local database.
demoContent.cmdClean: Deletes every sample record from the database.
